The '''Columex system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Columex/Legends|Columex]].
